Metadata.title: Accordo — New and used musical instruments
Metadata.description: Buy and sell musical instruments, audio, DJ and lighting gear with protected payments and verified feedback.

Home.title: Buy and sell musical instruments safely
Home.subtitle: Free listings for instruments, audio, DJ and lighting. You pay on the platform and the seller is paid only after you confirm you received the item.
Home.protectedText: Your payment is held until you confirm receipt or the inspection window ends.
Home.feedbackText: Only buyers and sellers who completed a real order on the platform can leave feedback.
Home.safetyText: In-app chat with filters, non-clickable external links and identity-verified sellers.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back to Accordo.
signIn.twoFactorHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Listing is free. Buy and sell with protected payments.
signUp.name: Full name
signUp.terms: I accept the <terms>Terms of service</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.
signUp.marketing: Send me news and offers by email (optional).
signUp.googleNotice: By continuing with Google you accept the Terms of service.

verifyEmail.title: Email confirmation
verifyEmail.ok: Email address confirmed. Your account is active.
verifyEmail.error: The link is invalid or has expired. Sign in to get a new one.
verifyEmail.pending: Open the link we emailed you to confirm your address.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.text: Enter your account email: we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If the address is registered, you will shortly receive an email with the link.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password updated. You can now sign in.
reset.invalid: The link is invalid or has expired.

StepUp.title: Confirm it's you
StepUp.text: To protect your account, please confirm your identity.
StepUp.newDevice: You are on a new device: we also email you a code.

Account.title: My account
Account.overviewText: Manage your profile, addresses, security and preferences here. Listings, purchases and sales are coming soon.
Account.emailUnverified: Your email address is not confirmed yet.
Account.twoFactorHint: Protect your account: turn on two-step verification.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.bioHelp: Up to 1,000 characters. Do not include contact details: they would be removed.
profile.comuneHelp: Your profile only shows the town, never your address.
profile.marketing: Receive news and offers by email

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.intro: Shipping addresses for your purchases and the sender address for your sales.
addresses.empty: You have no saved addresses yet.
addresses.phoneHelp: Needed by the courier, never shown to other users.

security.title: Security
security.newDeviceAlert: You reported a suspicious sign-in: sign out of all other devices and change your password.

password.title: Password
password.done: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.recommended: Recommended for sellers; mandatory for staff.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or 1Password), then enter the generated code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to set up the authenticator app
twoFactor.backupHelp: Keep them somewhere safe: each one lets you sign in if you lose your phone.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your device fingerprint, face or PIN, no password needed.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other devices

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose how to receive each kind of alert. Order, payment and security messages are always on.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: You can change your consent to optional cookies at any time.

export.title: Export your data
export.text: Full data export is coming soon. Meanwhile you can request it from support.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Your personal data will be anonymised and your listings removed. Orders and feedback are kept anonymously to meet legal obligations. This cannot be undone.

responseTime.WITHIN_HOURS: Usually replies within a few hours

Profile.blockConfirm: Block this user? They will not be able to message you or make offers.
Profile.signInToFollow: Sign in to follow this user.

Consent.title: We respect your privacy
Consent.text: We use technical cookies required for the site to work. With your consent we would also use anonymous statistics to improve it. You can change your mind at any time from “Cookie preferences” at the bottom of the page.
Consent.necessaryText: Session, security and preferences. Always on.
